plan: 正向：把 W 连同 add_mem'/zero_mem'/smul_mem' 打包成 Submodule 结构字面量，零元用 zero_smul 从非空推出。反向：Submodule 的三条封闭性直接给 IsSubspace 的三条。

theorem isSubspace_iff_exists_submodule {K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V]
    [LinearSpace K V] (W : Set V) :
    IsSubspace K W ↔ ∃ S : Submodule K V, (S : Set V) = W := by
  constructor
  · intro hW
    refine ⟨{ carrier := W
              add_mem' := fun ha hb => hW.2.1 ha hb
              zero_mem' := ?_
              smul_mem' := fun c _x hx => hW.2.2 c hx }, rfl⟩
    rcases hW.1 with ⟨z, hz⟩
    have h0 : (0 : K) • z = (0 : V) := zero_smul K z
    rw [← h0]
    exact hW.2.2 0 hz
  · rintro ⟨S, hS⟩
    rw [← hS]
    exact ⟨⟨0, S.zero_mem⟩, (fun ha hb => S.add_mem ha hb),
      (fun c _x hx => S.smul_mem c hx)⟩
